plot: On a windy autumn beach day Max walks sideways with Pinch the crab on a big rock and forgets to watch the water until the sea surrounds him; one jump to a slippery rock only wets his front paws, so he stays put and sends Bird for help, dips his scarf and finds the water is very shallow, and the twist is that 'Super Dog' can't swim because the sea only reaches his ankles while Grandma (planted: tall rain boots, 'flat like a plate') strolls over, and Dog carries Max back as a dry 'dog boat'.

script.title: Stuck on a Rock as the Sea Comes In

beats.say: Bird! Water all around my rock! Where did the sand go?
My paws can't get wet! Cats and water? No, no, no!

beats.text: STUCK AS THE SEA COMES IN!

beats.say: Twenty minutes earlier. A cool, windy autumn day at the beach.
Grandma sits on her blanket in her tall green rain boots.
The sea comes in slowly here.
The sand is flat, like a big plate.
So stay close, Max. And keep an eye on the water.
I will! I'm only going to the big rock.
Just for one little look. Back in a minute!
There's a tiny crab on the big rock! Come and see!
Max walks across the wet sand to the big rock.
Behind him, the waves are still far away.
On top sits a tiny red crab. Her name is Pinch.
Hello, big cat. Walk sideways, like me. It's much more fun.
Sideways? Okay! Step, step, step... I'm a crab cat!
Ha! Max the sideways cat! Do it again!
Step, step, step. Click, click, click. I'm the best crab ever!
Max walks sideways, back and forth, for a long, long time.
And nobody watches the water. Not even once.
Swish. Swish. The waves come in and fill the sand.
Wait. Why are my toes cold? Why is the sand shiny?
Water! Water on the left! Water on the right! Everywhere!
Your rock is an island now! A tiny cat island!
I have to get back to Grandma before the water gets higher!
A little rock sticks out of the water near the big one.
I'll jump to that little rock. Then I'll run! Easy!
Max jumps. But the little rock is slippery and green.
His front paws go splash, right into the cold sea.
Cold! Wet! Yuck! Back, back, back!
Max scrambles back up the big rock. His paws drip.
The water is coming up! My rock is getting smaller!
Don't move, Max! I'll fly and get help. Fast as I can!
Now Max is all alone on the rock. Well, nearly alone.
Why are you so scared, big cat? I'm not scared at all.
You're a crab! You like water!
I'm a cat! I'm a dry cat! Dry!
Look down. I walk to my home on the bottom every day.
Max dips the end of his long red scarf into the water.
He pulls it up. Only the very tip is wet.
Huh? The sea is only as deep as a mouse?
Is that right? It looks so big!
But the sea makes a big wave noise, and Max isn't sure.
Then, across the beach, comes a very loud splash.
Don't worry, Max! Super Dog is coming to rescue you!
Dog runs into the sea, ready to swim like a hero.
But the water only comes up to Dog's ankles.
Dog, you're walking in the sea! Like a dog on stilts!
Huh? I can't swim. It's too shallow to swim. I'm just... walking.
And behind Dog walks Grandma, in her tall green rain boots.
Splish, splosh. Remember, Max? Flat like a plate.
Flat like a plate! So I was never really on an island?
No, dear. But you were right to stay on the rock.
And you were right to send Bird for help.
Fastest help in the whole beach! Did you see me fly?
But I still don't want wet paws. Not one more drop.
Then climb on my back! I'm a dog boat! All aboard!
Max climbs onto Dog's back and holds on with all four paws.
Goodbye, Pinch! Thank you for the sideways lesson!
Next time, big cat, watch the water and the sand.
Splish, splosh, splish. The dog boat walks back to the blanket.
Captain Dog says: dry cat delivered! Toot toot!
Max jumps down onto the dry, warm blanket.
Not a single wet toe. Well, maybe two.
Grandma, I promise. Next time I watch the water, not my feet.
That's my clever cat. Now, who wants a warm towel cuddle?
At the beach, always keep an eye on the sea.
And if you're stuck, call for help.
Tomorrow I'm teaching Grandma to walk sideways like a crab!
In my rain boots? Oh dear. Sideways it is!

long.title: Stuck on a Rock as the Sea Comes In! 🌊
long.description:
"I only looked at a crab for one minute. Now there's water everywhere!" 🐱
On a windy autumn day at the beach, Max is so busy walking sideways with Pinch the crab that the sea sneaks in all around his rock. How will a cat who hates wet paws get back to Grandma? Max the Curious Cat, Ep 46.

es.description:

#MaxTheCuriousCat #series #3DAnimation

pt.title: Preso numa pedra com o mar subindo! 🌊

#MaxTheCuriousCat #series #3DAnimation

#MaxTheCuriousCat #series #3DAnimation
